Task (3D, static): write an HTML page that builds the scene from code and renders it so that the view from your reference camera reproduces the image as faithfully as you can: characters, poses, facial expressions, hands, props, background, and colors. A later step will animate your scene, so structure it in named groups. For this static step, render(t) may ignore t. three.js contract: - The harness injects an import map for three.js r187. Import from 'three' and from 'three/addons/'; the only addons available are 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ConvexGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricFunctions.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js', 'three/addons/math/ConvexHull.js', 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js'. <!doctype html>

<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const width = 240;
const height = 242;
const scale = 48;
const tilt = .34;
const sin = Math.sin(tilt);
const cos = Math.cos(tilt);
const up = new THREE.Vector3(0, cos, -sin);
const forward = new THREE.Vector3(0, sin, cos);
const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xbbafa0);

const ref = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-120 / scale, 120 / scale, 121 / scale, -121 / scale, .1, 60);
ref.name = 'reference-camera';
ref.position.copy(forward).multiplyScalar(13);
ref.lookAt(0, 0, 0);

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true, antialias: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(width, height);
renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFShadowMap;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

function view(x, y, depth = 0) {
  const h = (121 - y) / scale;
  return new THREE.Vector3((x - 120) / scale, h * cos + depth * sin, -h * sin + depth * cos);
}

function onTable(x, y, level) {
  return view(x, y, (level - (121 - y) / scale * cos) / sin);
}

function onWall(x, y, z) {
  return new THREE.Vector3((x - 120) / scale, ((121 - y) / scale + z * sin) / cos, z);
}

function group(parent, name, position) {
  const object = new THREE.Group();
  object.name = name;
  parent.add(object);
  if (position) object.position.copy(parent.worldToLocal(position.clone()));
  return object;
}

function mesh(parent, geometry, material, name, shadows = true) {
  const object = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
  object.name = name;
  object.castShadow = shadows;
  object.receiveShadow = shadows;
  parent.add(object);
  return object;
}

function matte(color, settings = {}) {
  return new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color, roughness: .84, ...settings });
}

function flat(color, settings = {}) {
  return new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color, side: THREE.DoubleSide, ...settings });
}

function texture(sample, srgb = false) {
  const size = 64;
  const data = new Uint8Array(size * size * 4);
  for (let y = 0; y < size; ++y) {
    for (let x = 0; x < size; ++x) {
      data.set(sample(x, y), (y * size + x) * 4);
    }
  }
  const result = new THREE.DataTexture(data, size, size);
  if (srgb) result.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
  result.magFilter = THREE.LinearFilter;
  result.minFilter = THREE.LinearMipmapLinearFilter;
  result.generateMipmaps = true;
  result.needsUpdate = true;
  return result;
}

function noise(x, y) {
  const n = Math.sin(x * 127.1 + y * 311.7 + 17.3) * 43758.5453;
  return n - Math.floor(n);
}

const nap = texture((x, y) => {
  const value = 104 + 52 * noise(x, y) + 11 * Math.sin(x * .82 + y * .39);
  return [value, value, value, 255];
});
nap.wrapS = nap.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
nap.repeat.set(2, 2);

const woodGrain = texture((x, y) => {
  const line = y + .49 * Math.sin(x * .137 + y * .53) + .29 * Math.sin(x * .29 - y * .24);
  const value = 241 + 4 * Math.cos(line * .79) + 4 * Math.sin(line * 1.91)
    + 5 * Math.cos(line * .36) + 6 * (noise(x, y) - .5);
  return [value, value - 2, value - 5, 255];
}, true);
woodGrain.wrapS = woodGrain.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
woodGrain.repeat.set(.36, .68);

const paperGrain = texture((x, y) => {
  const value = 247 + 8 * noise(x, y) - 2 * noise(x, Math.floor(y / 3));
  return [value, value, value - 1, 255];
}, true);

function grid(columns, rows, sample, reverse = false) {
  const positions = [];
  const uv = [];
  const indices = [];
  for (let row = 0; row <= rows; ++row) {
    for (let column = 0; column <= columns; ++column) {
      const u = column / columns;
      const v = row / rows;
      const p = sample(u, v);
      positions.push(p.x, p.y, p.z);
      uv.push(u, v);
    }
  }
  for (let row = 0; row < rows; ++row) {
    for (let column = 0; column < columns; ++column) {
      const a = row * (columns + 1) + column;
      const b = a + 1;
      const d = a + columns + 1;
      const c = d + 1;
      if (reverse) indices.push(a, d, b, b, d, c);
      else indices.push(a, b, d, b, c, d);
    }
  }
  const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geometry.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
  geometry.setAttribute('uv', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uv, 2));
  geometry.setIndex(indices);
  geometry.computeVertexNormals();
  return geometry;
}

function smoothSeam(geometry, columns, rows) {
  const normal = geometry.attributes.normal;
  const a = new THREE.Vector3();
  const b = new THREE.Vector3();
  for (let row = 0; row <= rows; ++row) {
    const start = row * (columns + 1);
    const end = start + columns;
    a.fromBufferAttribute(normal, start).add(b.fromBufferAttribute(normal, end)).normalize();
    normal.setXYZ(start, a.x, a.y, a.z);
    normal.setXYZ(end, a.x, a.y, a.z);
  }
}

function quad(parent, name, points, material, shadows = false) {
  const [a, b, c, d] = points;
  return mesh(parent, grid(1, 1, (u, v) =>
    a.clone().lerp(b, u).lerp(d.clone().lerp(c, u), v)), material, name, shadows);
}

function sphere(parent, name, position, dimensions, material, rotation = 0) {
  const object = mesh(parent, new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 30, 20), material, name);
  object.position.copy(parent.worldToLocal(position.clone()));
  const rotationInView = new THREE.Matrix4().makeBasis(
    new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0), up, forward
  );
  object.quaternion.setFromRotationMatrix(rotationInView);
  object.rotateZ(rotation);
  object.scale.set(dimensions[0] / scale, dimensions[1] / scale, dimensions[2] / scale);
  return object;
}

function smoothValues(rows, t) {
  const s = t * (rows.length - 1);
  const i = Math.min(rows.length - 2, Math.floor(s));
  const f = s - i;
  const p0 = rows[Math.max(0, i - 1)];
  const p1 = rows[i];
  const p2 = rows[i + 1];
  const p3 = rows[Math.min(rows.length - 1, i + 2)];
  return p1.map((value, k) => {
    const m1 = (p2[k] - p0[k]) * .5;
    const m2 = (p3[k] - p1[k]) * .5;
    return value + f * (m1 + f * (3 * (p2[k] - value) - 2 * m1 - m2
      + f * (2 * (value - p2[k]) + m1 + m2)));
  });
}

function sweep(parent, name, points, material, thickness = 1, sides = 26) {
  const vertices = points.map(p => parent.worldToLocal(view(p[0], p[1], p[2])));
  const line = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(vertices);
  const radii = points.map(p => [p[3]]);
  const steps = Math.max(24, points.length * 7);
  const frames = [];
  for (let j = 0; j <= steps; ++j) {
    const t = j / steps;
    const tangent = line.getTangent(t).normalize();
    const widthAxis = tangent.clone().cross(forward);
    if (widthAxis.lengthSq() < .00001) widthAxis.set(1, 0, 0);
    widthAxis.normalize();
    const depthAxis = tangent.clone().cross(widthAxis).normalize();
    frames.push([line.getPoint(t), widthAxis, depthAxis, Math.max(0, smoothValues(radii, t)[0]) / scale]);
  }
  const geometry = grid(sides, steps, (u, v) => {
    const [center, widthAxis, depthAxis, radius] = frames[Math.round(v * steps)];
    const angle = u * Math.PI * 2;
    return center.clone().addScaledVector(widthAxis, radius * Math.cos(angle))
      .addScaledVector(depthAxis, radius * thickness * Math.sin(angle));
  });
  const positions = Array.from(geometry.attributes.position.array);
  const texcoords = Array.from(geometry.attributes.uv.array);
  const indices = Array.from(geometry.index.array);
  for (const row of [0, steps]) {
    const centerIndex = positions.length / 3;
    positions.push(...frames[row][0].toArray());
    texcoords.push(.5, row / steps);
    const first = row * (sides + 1);
    for (let j = 0; j < sides; ++j) {
      if (row === 0) indices.push(centerIndex, first + j + 1, first + j);
      else indices.push(centerIndex, first + j, first + j + 1);
    }
  }
  geometry.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
  geometry.setAttribute('uv', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(texcoords, 2));
  geometry.setIndex(indices);
  geometry.computeVertexNormals();
  smoothSeam(geometry, sides, steps);
  return mesh(parent, geometry, material, name);
}

const dressing = group(scene, 'classroom');

  const shade = 4.3 * (noise(x, y) - .5) + 6 * Math.sin(u * 3.1)

}, true);
const wallZ = -5.5;
quad(dressing, 'plaster-wall', [[-240,-180],[440,-180],[440,340],[-240,340]]

const feather = texture((x, y) => {

  const v = (y - 31.5) / 31.5;
  const r = Math.sqrt(u * u + v * v);
  return [255, 255, 255, 255 * Math.max(0, 1 - r * r) ** 2];
});
function softPatch(parent, name, corners, color, opacity) {
  return quad(parent, name, corners, flat(color, {
    map: feather, transparent: true, opacity, depthWrite: false
  }));
}
softPatch(dressing, 'chalkboard-wall-shadow',

const board = group(dressing, 'chalkboard');
const boardMap = texture((x, y) => {

  return [13 + dust, 34 + dust, 40 + dust, 255];
}, true);
const wallShape = (name, points, z, material) =>

wallShape('wooden-frame', [[55,-62],[328,-60],[328,31],[57,39]], -5.45, flat(0x80705b));
wallShape('inner-frame', [[61,-61],[325,-61],[325,28],[62,35]], -5.43, flat(0x4e4536));
wallShape('slate', [[72,-60],[324,-60],[324,26],[70,33]], -5.42, flat(0xffffff, { map: boardMap }));

softPatch(dressing, 'warm-shadow-below-board',

softPatch(dressing, 'background-chair-shadow',

function slab(parent, name, points, y, thickness, bevel, top, edge, shadow = true) {
  const shape = new THREE.Shape();
  points.forEach((p, i) => {
    const q = onTable(p[0], p[1], y);
    if (i === 0) shape.moveTo(q.x, -q.z);
    else shape.lineTo(q.x, -q.z);
  });
  shape.closePath();
  const geometry = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(shape, {
    depth: thickness, bevelEnabled: bevel > 0, bevelSize: bevel,
    bevelThickness: bevel, bevelSegments: 2, steps: 1
  });
  const object = mesh(parent, geometry, [top, edge], name, shadow);
  object.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
  object.position.y = y - thickness - bevel;
  return object;
}

const rear = group(dressing, 'rear-desks');
slab(rear, 'rear-desktop', [[-46,84],[259,84],[276,97],[-32,100]], -.88, .15, .04,

slab(rear, 'second-desk-at-right', [[174,103],[293,98],[296,121],[178,128]], -1.02, .20, .035,

const book = group(scene, 'open-exercise-book');
const paper = matte(0xfff2d7, { map: paperGrain, side: THREE.DoubleSide });
const lightPaper = matte(0xfff4de, { map: paperGrain, side: THREE.DoubleSide });
const cutPaper = matte(0xd8c9aa, { side: THREE.DoubleSide });
const paperLine = matte(0xb6a889, { side: THREE.DoubleSide });

const leftCorners = [[94,226],[15,234],[1,214],[61,200]];
const rightCorners = [[94,226],[168,221],[120,199],[61,200]];
function leaf(corners, right, u, v, offset = 0) {
  const [a, b, c, d] = corners;
  const x = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(THREE.MathUtils.lerp(a[0], b[0], u), THREE.MathUtils.lerp(d[0], c[0], u), v);
  const y = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(THREE.MathUtils.lerp(a[1], b[1], u), THREE.MathUtils.lerp(d[1], c[1], u), v);
  const arch = Math.sin(Math.PI * u) ** (right ? .79 : 1.18);
  const rise = .047 + arch * (right ? .105 : .087)
    + .027 * u ** 5 + (.017 + .018 * u) * Math.sin(Math.PI * v) + .014 * v;
  const p = onTable(x, y, tableY);
  p.y += rise + offset;
  return p;
}

for (const [right, corners] of [[false, leftCorners], [true, rightCorners]]) {
  const stack = group(book, right ? 'right-page-stack' : 'left-page-stack');
  const surface = (u, v, offset = 0) => leaf(corners, right, u, v, offset);
  mesh(stack, grid(30, 14, (u,v) => surface(u,v), !right), right ? lightPaper : paper, 'top-leaf');
  mesh(stack, grid(30, 14, (u,v) => surface(u,v,-.047), !right), cover, 'cover');
  for (const edge of [
    u => [u,0], u => [u,1], u => [1,u]
  ]) {
    mesh(stack, grid(28, 1, (u,v) => surface(...edge(u), -.048 * v)),
      cutPaper, 'cut-page-edges');
    for (const offset of [-.014,-.028,-.039]) {
      mesh(stack, grid(24, 1, (u,v) => {
        const [s,t] = edge(u);
        const point = surface(s,t,offset + v * .0025);
        if (t === 0) point.z += .003;
        else if (t === 1) point.z -= .003;
        else point.x += right ? .003 : -.003;
        return point;
      }), paperLine, 'fine-page-layer', false);
    }
  }
}

const fold = matte(0xafa18b, { side: THREE.DoubleSide });
mesh(book, grid(2, 18, (u,v) => {

function rod(parent, name, a, b, startRadius, endRadius, material, sides = 14) {
  const delta = b.clone().sub(a);
  const object = mesh(parent,
    new THREE.CylinderGeometry(endRadius / scale, startRadius / scale, delta.length(), sides),
    material, name);
  object.position.copy(parent.worldToLocal(a.clone().lerp(b, .5)));
  object.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0), delta.normalize());
  return object;
}

const graphite = matte(0x35332c, { roughness: .51 });

function deskPen(name, start, end, material, radius) {

  const b = onTable(...end, tableY + radius / scale);

  rod(parent, 'end-cap', along(.89), b, radius * 1.1, radius * .9, darkPen);
  if (radius > 1) {
    const bump = new THREE.Vector3(0, radius / scale, 0);
    rod(parent, 'metal-clip', along(.69).add(bump), along(.92).add(bump), .29, .24, ferrule);
  }
}
deskPen('pen-near-notebook', [177,214], [225,227], lacquer, 1.18);

function gaussian(x, y, cx, cy, rx, ry) {
  return Math.exp(-(((x - cx) / rx) ** 2 + ((y - cy) / ry) ** 2));
}

function makeBody(character, isRight, keyRows) {
  const head = group(character, 'head', isRight ? view(155,95,-.43) : view(59,109,.12));
  const torso = group(character, 'torso');
  const baseBone = new THREE.Bone();
  baseBone.name = 'body-bind';
  torso.add(baseBone);
  const headBone = new THREE.Bone();
  headBone.name = 'head-bind';
  head.add(headBone);

  const radial = 100;
  const vertical = 128;
  const rows = Array.from({ length: vertical + 1 }, (_,i) => smoothValues(keyRows, i / vertical));
  const color = new THREE.Color();
  const yellow = new THREE.Color(isRight ? 0xf9b52c : 0xf8b630);
  const cream = new THREE.Color(isRight ? 0xeed4a3 : 0xedd3a2);
  const gold = new THREE.Color(0xd5932d);
  const colors = [];
  const boneIndices = [];
  const weights = [];

  function muzzle(x, y, face) {
    if (face <= 0) return 0;
    const shape = isRight
      ? .163 * gaussian(x,y,125,82,11,7.8) + .048 * gaussian(x,y,135,94,13,5)
      : .092 * gaussian(x,y,75,103,12,8) + .034 * gaussian(x,y,76,114,15,5);
    return shape * Math.sqrt(face);
  }

  const geometry = grid(radial, vertical, (u,v) => {
    const [y,cx,rx,d,rz] = rows[Math.round(v * vertical)];
    const angle = u * Math.PI * 2;
    const front = Math.sin(angle);
    const x = cx + Math.max(0,rx) * Math.cos(angle);
    const depth = d + Math.max(0,rz) / scale * front + muzzle(x,y,front);
    const angleFromPatch = angle - (isRight ? 1.44 : 1.49);
    const patch =
      (angleFromPatch / (isRight ? .83 : .965)) ** 2
      + ((y - (isRight ? 193 : 183)) / (isRight ? 41 : 43)) ** 2;
    const mottling = .029 * Math.sin(x * .34 + y * .14) * Math.cos(y * .43 - u * 12)
      + .018 * Math.sin(y * .23 + u * 47);
    const belly = 1 - THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(patch + mottling,.84,1.13);
    const blush = isRight ? gaussian(x,y,127,95,13,15) : gaussian(x,y,71,114,21,15);
    color.copy(yellow).lerp(gold, .19 * blush * Math.max(0, front)).lerp(cream, belly);
    color.multiplyScalar(1 + mottling * .64 + .035 * Math.sin(y * .055 + u * 7));
    colors.push(color.r,color.g,color.b);
    const headWeight = 1 - THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(y,isRight ? 100 : 115,isRight ? 138 : 144);
    boneIndices.push(0,1,0,0);
    weights.push(1 - headWeight,headWeight,0,0);
    return torso.worldToLocal(view(x,y,depth));
  });
  smoothSeam(geometry,radial,vertical);
  geometry.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors,3));
  geometry.setAttribute('skinIndex', new THREE.Uint16BufferAttribute(boneIndices,4));
  geometry.setAttribute('skinWeight', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(weights,4));
  const skin = new THREE.SkinnedMesh(geometry, matte(0xffffff, {
    vertexColors: true, bumpMap: nap, bumpScale: .008, roughness: .9
  }));
  skin.name = 'continuous-yellow-body';
  skin.castShadow = skin.receiveShadow = true;
  torso.add(skin);
  scene.updateMatrixWorld(true);
  skin.bind(new THREE.Skeleton([baseBone,headBone]), skin.matrixWorld);

  function faceDepth(x, y) {
    let i = 1;
    while (i < rows.length - 1 && rows[i][0] < y) ++i;
    const a = rows[i-1];
    const b = rows[i];
    const t = THREE.MathUtils.clamp((y-a[0]) / (b[0]-a[0]),0,1);
    const [,cx,rx,d,rz] = a.map((n,k) => THREE.MathUtils.lerp(n,b[k],t));
    const fraction = THREE.MathUtils.clamp((x-cx) / rx,-1,1);
    const face = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,1-fraction*fraction));
    return d + rz / scale * face + muzzle(x,y,face);
  }
  return { head, faceDepth };
}

function eye(face, name, x, y, rx, ry, nx, gaze, rim = eyeRim) {
  const center = view(x,y,face.faceDepth(x,y) + .008);

    .addScaledVector(up,-.06).normalize();

  const upward = look.clone().cross(rightward).normalize();
  part.quaternion.setFromRotationMatrix(new THREE.Matrix4().makeBasis(rightward,upward,look));
  const eyeball = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,28,20);

  function layer(name, position, size, material) {
    const object = mesh(part,eyeball,material,name,false);
    object.position.set(...position.map(n => n / scale));
    object.scale.set(...size.map(n => n / scale));
    return object;
  }
  layer('socket', [0,0,-.75], [rx+1.05,ry+.8,3.3], rim);
  layer('gray-eye', [0,0,.2], [rx,ry,3.7], eyeGray);
  layer('iris', [gaze[0],gaze[1],2.62], [rx*.72,ry*.76,1.65], iris);
  layer('pupil', [gaze[0]+.32,gaze[1]-.19,3.72], [rx*.49,ry*.55,.97], pupil);
  layer('catchlight', [gaze[0]-1.68,gaze[1]+2.16,4.43], [.67,.73,.20], glint);
}

function mouth(face, knots, isRight) {
  const center = knots[Math.floor(knots.length / 2)];

  const lip = matte(isRight ? 0xd99b32 : 0xe6a23b, { side: THREE.DoubleSide });
  mesh(part, grid(40, 4, (u,v) => {
    const [x, y, top, bottom] = smoothValues(knots,u);
    const py = y + THREE.MathUtils.lerp(-top,bottom,v);
    return part.worldToLocal(view(x,py,face.faceDepth(x,py) + .015 + .009 * Math.sin(u*Math.PI)));
  }), slit, 'smile-opening', false);
  mesh(part, grid(40, 2, (u,v) => {
    const [x,y,,bottom] = smoothValues(knots,u);
    const py = y + bottom + .3 + v * .72 * Math.sin(u*Math.PI);
    return part.worldToLocal(view(x,py,face.faceDepth(x,py) + .013));
  }), lip, 'lower-lip', false);
}
